lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: Protocol, database and native checks use explicitly synthetic verifiers; no hosted run for this working-tree revision has been observed.
findings.user_impact: Local tests cannot establish real repository artifact compatibility or enrollment of a particular user case.
findings.recommendation: Keep hosted verification unavailable until operator trust and the selected-case workflow are configured; obtain an exact hosted receipt before claiming remote coverage.
findings.verification: Dispatch the reviewed workflow on an admitted branch and verify its case-bound artifact through the normal backend route.

strengths: Repository, attempt, report, case and rerun are independently bound; forged pass flags fail recomputation.
Source deletion and rerun expiry win over in-flight verification; receipt payloads are scrubbed.
Verified execution, failed integrity, semantic quality and release enforcement remain distinct.
Credential-bearing requests stay at the GitHub API origin; the bounded signed download carries no GitHub token.
missing_evidence: Actual hosted workflow and artifact readback
open_questions: The workflow uses an ordinary backend session; a dedicated synthetic-data account is required until a narrower CI credential exists.

lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The native critical path is verified on an English iPhone 17 Pro Simulator; Chinese, accessibility Dynamic Type and assistive-technology interaction are not release-verified in this milestone.
findings.user_impact: Localization coverage alone cannot exclude wrapping or navigation friction in these modes.
findings.recommendation: Cover these modes in the full Lab device/state review and retain the current internal-only boundary.
findings.verification: Navigate selection, full run identity, result and recovery in Chinese and accessibility sizes; inspect VoiceOver order.

strengths: Native full journey includes saved-case relaunch, rerun, successful and failing integrity receipts, export and deletion.
Stable-ID recovery cannot accept an unrelated case or rerun.
Long picker metadata was corrected to compact time with the complete selected run identity below.
Failed integrity is visible without relying on color and does not become a quality approval.
